guide.text: Scarecrow's signature gear. After casting a skill or the Ultimate, Attack and Physical Defense are permanently increased, stacking up to a cap. Also increases Physical Resistance. The Ultimate has a fixed chance to inflict [Mental Breakdown], incapacitating the target for a set duration.
